execution_log.summary: See thead_ledger.json (the critic reviewed both plans together). ttail-specific outcomes: the follow refusal moves from buildArgv to three overridden sinks with the rc-preserving spelling; toList joins the refused set (no kcl list calls TPipe.stop); each/first documented as blocking without a stopping consumer; follow tests kill their producer in teardown and give the appender >=3 s; +0 = everything, -0 = nothing (mirror of head).

Owner: start thead and ttail. Measured with thead (PLAN §1.1 there); tail-specific: -n +N = from line N (kk.isInt would silently turn +2 into 2 — the count regex passes it verbatim), -f follows until TERM (143, the tpipe stop path). Decision: with follow = 1 the sinks that can only finish at EOF (toArray, count) are refused with rc 2; each/toList/first stream until TPipe.stop; run streams until killed. PLAN.md + this ledger written. No code.
